definitions.explanation: The meal eaten in the evening. A casual, everyday word commonly used in homes and informal contexts.

examples.english: What shall we have for dinner?

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧だ。
{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I did my homework after eating dinner.

notes:
{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん} is a casual word for dinner.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧: dinner (also casual, slightly more common in some regions)
- ⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧: dinner (formal, used in writing and announcements)
- ⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧: dinner (neutral to slightly formal)
- ⟦{晩|ばん}{飯|めし}→晩飯：19760_banmeshi⟧: dinner (masculine, rough)

MEAL WORDS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧: breakfast
- ⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧: lunch
- {夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}: dinner
